prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Livermorium (Lv) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a boudoir photo set — a satin-draped chaise, a gilt mirror, sheer curtains glowing with window light and a scatter of rose petals
Time of day: cool white overhead light, flat and bright; flat white light with crisp edges, no warm glow.
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Small moment: a small glitter sticker sparkles on her cheek.
Outfit: a couture one-piece swimsuit edged with rows of small pearls along the neckline and straps — in bold navy-and-white stripes; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a textured crinkle swim fabric, a sheer button-up shirt worn open over it and a wide-brimmed hat, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the left of the frame; head turned with her body, the tip of her nose pointing toward the left of the frame; camera directly above her, looking straight down; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
PROP: with her own right hand she brushes her hair with a hairbrush; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one eye closed in a playful wink while the other stays open and bright, one mouth corner lifted in a small smile, brows relaxed.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — livermorium: a synthetic superheavy element first made in 2000 by firing calcium ions at a curium target, in a joint effort between a northern science town and a laboratory across the ocean, and named for that laboratory and its valley town; the valley has been known for its vineyards since the 1880s, and in 1889 one of its wines won a gold medal at a great world exhibition; today the laboratory houses the largest laser on Earth, a building the size of three playing fields that focuses one hundred and ninety-two beams onto a single point and, in the winter of 2022, first drew more energy from that point than it put in; it sits below oxygen, sulfur, selenium, tellurium and polonium, and its atoms last only tens of milliseconds before decaying into flerovium — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
